# Fox greeting GIF workflow

[← Back to all cases](../../README.md#all-cases)

<a href="README.md"><img src="../../assets/badges/language-en-current.svg" alt="Current language: English" height="34" /></a> <a href="README.zh-CN.md"><img src="../../assets/badges/language-zh-CN.svg" alt="View translation: 简体中文" height="34" /></a>

**Creator-reported model · Source-only; not independently reproduced**

Two visually distinct fox outputs form one greeting workflow. Both files are GIF, 336 × 336, 9 frames at 200 ms each (1.8 seconds). All 18 frames across the two GIFs were decoded and visually inspected. This is not timed playback or verification of a seamless loop. The tutorial prompt belongs to its own output only; no identical-prompt claim for the launch output.
